action.objective: Verify reserved candidate f2f3 at depth 4 as the sole focused analysis.
action.rationale: Broad depth-4 search over all legal moves cut off at depth 2 (3000 nodes) and found no commit-ready move; strongest exact evidence is f2f3 at -1. Single-candidate verification of the reserved move f2f3 uses its 2000-node allowance at max_depth 4 to obtain deeper, commit-ready evidence.
